refnamediv.refpurpose: run a shell or command as another user via PtyBroker

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para:
exec0 runs a shell or a command as another user, by default root, using
systemd-ptybrokerd8 . Authentication and authorization are handled by polkit, which the broker consults before allocating a pseudo-terminal and running the requested command or shell on exec0's behalf.

Unlike su1, sudo8 or pkexec1, exec0 is not setuid itself and does not need to raise any privileges in the calling process: the privileged part of the work is done by systemd-ptybrokerd8 over its own, separate IPC mechanism. This makes exec0 a working alternative to su, sudo and pkexec on systems, or for processes, that have the Linux NoNewPrivs flag set, which otherwise prevents setuid binaries from gaining privileges.

exec0 is also the real binary behind the exec0-pkexec1, exec0-su1 and exec0-sudo1 wrappers, which are only different command lines on top of the same mechanism; invoked as plain exec0, it uses its own native command line described below rather than emulating any other tool.
With no command given, exec0 runs a shell for the target user, the same as -s/--shell.

listitem.para: Set an ANSI SGR color parameter string (e.g. 1;44) to use as the terminal background for the session. An empty string clears a background color set by the configuration file.

Change the working directory before running the command. By default, exec0 stays in the caller's current directory, except with -i/--login, which switches to the target user's home directory unless overridden by this option.
Set a human-readable description for the pty session, shown in the polkit authentication prompt.

Preserve the whole calling environment when running the command. If a comma-separated list of variable names is given instead, only those variables are preserved, the rest of the environment is reset. Cannot be combined with -i/--login.
Run the command with group as primary group, instead of the target user's own primary group.
Run a login shell as the target user. Implies switching to the target user's home directory, unless -D/--chdir is also given. Cannot be combined with -s/--shell or -E/--preserve-env.
Set the name of the pty session.
Be quiet; disables -v/--verbose, including when the latter was enabled by the configuration file.
Run a shell as the target user. This is the default when no command is given.
Run the command as the specified user instead of root.

refsect1.title: Environment
refsect1.para: Any VAR=value arguments before command are set in the environment passed to it, the same way sudo8 treats leading assignments; unless -E/--preserve-env is also used to preserve the whole environment, each assignment is implicitly added to the set of preserved variables.

refsect1.title: Files
refsect1.para: /etc/exec0/exec0.conf, and the other configuration directories handled by libeconf3, are read for defaults. A [Global] section applies to exec0 and all wrappers; a section named after the invoked tool (e.g. [exec0]) overrides it. Recognized keys are verbose (boolean) and background (an ANSI SGR color parameter string, see --background above), both overridable on the command line.
